The exhibitions in Sadská are a beautiful example of a community event organised by the cultural centre and the local volunteer fire brigade

There was nothing to fault about the event – beautiful weather, active spectators and even the deputy mayor, pulled out by mistake as a volunteer.

Hopefully our riding by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, Lukáš Valný and Ondra Nenadál entertained kids and adults – thanks for the invitation.
